title: fix(poweredBy): fixed Algolia logo version
body:

![algolia-light- 1](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/29529/18005347/be00af86-6b99-11e6-9fb5-b7ca1ac7645d.png)

comments.body: By analyzing the blame information on this pull request, we identified @pixelastic to be a potential reviewer

> Does It Scales?™️

The image is twice the size specified in the CSS: it's the basic/simple way to support retina screen.
I am ok updating the logo to the latest design, just worried that we need to maybe go a bit further to really solve #1222 in case it's still blurry (that's the initial request)
Updated to use the SVG version, [bye bye IE < 9](http://caniuse.com/#feat=svg-css).
That's ok for IE8, we do not support it.
